about_the_game:
Snap Flex

Snap Flex is a fast-paced, reflex-driven card game based on the classic Snap rules. Players take turns placing cards on the table. When two cards match in rank, the first to snap wins the pile. The goal is simple: collect all the cards to win.

Flex Mode introduces new ways to play:

  • Match both ranks and suits for a more dynamic, fast-paced experience.

  • Play with point-based scoring, where each successful snap earns points instead of an all-or-nothing win.

Game Modes:

  • Offline Play: Compete against CPU opponents or play locally with friends.

  • Online Multiplayer: Join or host a lobby with up to four players and test your reaction speed against others.

With simple mechanics and quick rounds, Snap Flex is easy to learn and fun for players of all ages.

Note: Online play includes a text chat feature.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz or better
  • Memory: 2,048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3-compatible GPU (Intel HD 4000, AMD Radeon HD 7000, NVIDIA GTX 600 series or better)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound card
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz+
  • Memory: 4,096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL 4.0+
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
